title: Recovery Check
summary: Shows what would lock a user out if they lost their phone: stale recovery contacts, no backup method, or one phone holding both keys.
description: Account-recovery checkup. Flags recovery email or phone not confirmed in months, no backup method, a password-only account, one phone acting as both second factor and recovery, and low backup codes, each with a fix callback.
catches: Recovery email or phone not confirmed within staleAfterDays (default 180)
The same phone used for SMS codes and recovery
Backup codes running low or all used
limits: Only as accurate as the RecoveryState you pass in
Does not verify that an email or phone still works; it reads the last-confirmed dates
Fixes run your onFix callback; nothing changes by itself
a11y: Section labelled by its title; open-issue summary in a polite live region
A failed fix shows role=alert text
After a fix, focus moves to the issue's "Fixed" marker
Severity is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone; icons are aria-hidden
server: checkRecovery is pure and can run on the server; the fixes themselves (adding factors, confirming contacts) must be verified server-side.
